items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 8:20:1
items.html:
The coupling of the male of Atik, etc., the part fit for the Nukva of Arich: Here the ARI was very brief, for he relied upon other places. For between the aforementioned coupling of Ibur [impregnation] and the coupling of the male with the Nukva of Atik, there was in between the coupling of Gadlut [greatness] through AB and SAG, which brought the bottom Hey out from the forehead to the Peh [mouth], and the ten Sefirot of the Rosh [head] and the Guf [body] of Atik came out at the level of Keter, as above (page 611, the passage beginning “Indeed”); for no coupling applies at the time when the Partzuf is in the discernment of Ibur, as is known. Rather, after the coupling of Gadlut of AB and SAG, when Atik and the Nukva attained the level of Keter, then they coupled and sorted the Nukva of AA. Also, he did not explain here how the male of AA was emanated, for he did not come down here to explain anything but the sortings of the females of Atzilut, how all of them are made from the name BON.
Indeed, in general the matters of MA and BON and the manner of their joining are very scattered throughout the words of the ARI, and also exceedingly brief, and it is very necessary to gather their essentials in one place, so that it will be possible to explain all the many details that the ARI brings before us.
And first we must understand the difference between the new MA and BON. And you should know that the entire difference lies in the matter of the ascent of the bottom Hey. In BON, all its vessels are found to be from the discernment of the bottom Hey in the Einayim, for so they came out from the beginning of their emanation. And in the new MA, all its vessels are regarded as being from the discernment of the bottom Hey that rose to the Galgalta, for so it came out from the beginning of its emanation. And everything that comes out in a Partzuf from the beginning of its emanation never changes; and although it afterwards receives an addition of Gadlut, the vessels of the Katnut [smallness] do not change because of this, and all the more so they do not increase. Rather, those same vessels, in the quantity and the nature that it had at the time of the Katnut, grow in level and in coarseness at the time of its Gadlut. Understand this and remember it.
And the coupling of Ibur of the new MA has already been explained: that its source is from the screen of the Guf of Nekudim, which was refined and rose up to the Rosh of SAG, and by force of its inclusion in the coupling there it thickened only in the measure of the coarseness of Keter. Therefore, when it coupled with the upper light, it raised reflected light only at the level of Malchut. And this is because its last phase, which it had in the Guf of Nekudim, is phase one, and it vanished with the refinement of the screen. However, you must remember that the discernment of clothing always remains, even from the last phase; and if so, here too there is phase one of clothing, and it turns out that the level of phase one, which is the level of ZA, also came out here, except that it is a discernment of a male, which has no coupling except by being included with the female, who has coarseness — for there is no coupling except from the discernment of coarseness, as above (in the Inner Observation, Part 6, item 14). And if so, there truly is a level of ZA here; but taking the discernment of the vessels into account, there are no vessels here except from the level of Malchut, and therefore it is called only by the name NHY, which are three Sefirot at the level of Malchut. Yet certainly there is there also the level of ZA, which is HGT, that is, three Sefirot in coarseness from the level of ZA, except that they are clothed inside the NHY, since this level comes from a record of clothing, from which there are no vessels.
And you should know that the essential name MA is the aforementioned level of ZA, for the level of Malchut is never called by the name MA. Therefore MA is always regarded as a discernment of half a Partzuf, of the male, because there is no coupling from its own discernment, since there is in it only the discernment of clothing alone, and it has no remedy except in its joining and inclusion with the coarseness of the discernment of the female. And thus the male and the female from the discernment of the new MA itself have been explained: they are the record of phase one of clothing, and the discernment of the bottom Hey that is in the Galgalta, which is the level of Malchut from the discernment of coarseness.
And here one must know a great principle: that the aforementioned female of the new MA, which is its Malchut, remained concealed in the Rosh of Atik, and indeed in all the Partzufim below Atik she is not revealed at all. And one should not ask, accordingly, how there is a discernment of MA in all the Partzufim, since MA is only a discernment of clothing, which is not fit for a coupling with the upper light, as above. Indeed, it is for this very reason that it joins with the coarseness that is in the records of the vessels of BON, and therefore BON is reckoned as the discernment of the female of MA; for its own Nukva serves only in the Rosh of Radla [the unknown head] alone, which is the first Rosh of the new MA, as above, and from there downward it takes for itself the records of the coarseness of BON as its own discernment of Nukva. And remember this.
Indeed, it has already been explained that even the MA of the first Rosh, although it has there a discernment of a Malchut of its own, as above, still sorted for itself the GAR [first three] of BON as a discernment of Nukva. However, this coupling is very hidden, and there are also doubts there in the matter of the discernments of the Nukva, as the ARI writes in the Gate of Radla in Etz Chaim; and this is not the place to elaborate upon them. And I have already explained the doubts in my commentary Panim Meirot and Panim Masbirot on Etz Chaim, from page 246 until page 259, and seek it from there.
And you should know that the bottom Hey that is concealed in the Rosh of Atik, as above, is revealed in the Guf, in the two lower thirds of the Netzah and Hod of Atik; and indeed for this reason they came out outside of Atzilut, in the secret of the two teats of the beast, as written in its place. But in all of Atzilut she has no revelation whatsoever, but only from the discernment of her illumination alone, and nothing at all from the discernment of her own self.
And the essential distinction between the vessels of MA and the vessels of BON is at the time of the Katnut, that is, in the Ibur. For from the side of the vessels of BON there must be, even from the discernment of Ibur, a complete level of ZA, that is, the three lines of HGT and the three lines of NHY; for the Katnut of BON is the bottom Hey in the Einayim, which leaves two vessels in the discernment of Atzilut in each of the degrees, which are Keter and Hochma, while Bina and ZON she brings out to the discernment of BYA, as is known. And therefore there are in every Partzuf two lights, Ruach and Nefesh, clothed in the two vessels Keter and Hochma. But from the side of the vessels of MA, where the bottom Hey rose to Keter, there did not remain in Atzilut, in each of the degrees, anything but one Sefira, which is the Sefira of Keter, and the nine lower ones of each of the degrees went out from the degree (as above, page 613, the passage beginning “And already,” study it there well). And therefore there is in the coupling of the Katnut only the discernment of the ZA of clothing, which is the discernment of HGT but has no vessels, as above, and the level of Malchut of coarseness, which does have vessels. And therefore HGT are compelled to clothe within NHY, that is, in the vessels of the level of Malchut.
And from what has been explained you will understand the difference between the GAR of Atzilut and the ZON of Atzilut. For in the GAR of Atzilut only two couplings apply, which are the coupling of Katnut, called Ibur, and the coupling of Gadlut. But in ZA three couplings apply, which are called Ibur, nursing, and Mochin.
And the reason is that there is a great difference between the females of the two Partzufim Atik and AA and the females of AVI and ZON. For the females in Atik and AA are from the discernment of the Keter of Nekudim, which the breaking did not touch at all, and therefore they remained in the whole of the light, from the ten Sefirot that were drawn to them from the Nikvey Einayim of SAG, that is, in the whole measure that came out at the time of the Katnut of Nekudim. And therefore it turns out that at the time of the coupling of Atik and the Nukva, to bring out the discernment of the Katnut of AA, which is called Ibur, it is born from there at a complete level of ZA, which are the lights of Ruach and Nefesh in the vessels of HGT and NHY. And although the male of Atik is a discernment of MA, which has no vessels in its HGT, being a discernment of the ZA of clothing, as above, still, through its stay in the discernment of the womb of the Nukva of Atik — whose Katnut too is from the bottom Hey that is in the Nikvey Einayim — it acquires the vessels of HGT that apply in the Nikvey Einayim. Thus even the first coupling, of the Katnut of Atik and the Nukva, brought out the Partzuf of AA at a complete level of ZA, with vessels of HGT and vessels of NHY. And in like manner, when AA and the Nukva coupled for the need of the Katnut of AVI, which is called Ibur, they too were born at a complete level of ZA; for the Nukva of AA too does not need her male in the discernment of the coupling of Katnut, being a discernment of the Keter of Nekudim, and therefore she gave AVI the vessels of HGT from the discernment of the bottom Hey in the Einayim, and AVI came out with complete vessels of HGT and NHY. Except that they lack GAR, and therefore they rose as MAN [Mayin Nukvin] a second time for the coupling of Gadlut, in which Atik and the Nukva emanated the GAR to AA at one time. And likewise AA and the Nukva coupled and emanated the GAR to AVI. Thus in two couplings all their wholeness was completed.
Not so ZA. For in AVI the Nukva is not in her wholeness even from the discernment of the Katnut of BON, and therefore even the discernment of the Katnut of BON must be received from her male, from the discernment of MA, as the ARI writes (in Etz Chaim, Gate 40, Discourse 8, see there). And it turns out that the coupling of AVI of Katnut, for the need of the Ibur of ZON, was in the Ibur by force of MA; and since MA is only the level of ZA from the discernment of clothing, and from the discernment of coarseness it has nothing but the level of Malchut, therefore it has nothing but the vessels of NHY alone, and the level of HGT is then compelled to clothe within NHY. And it turns out because of this that ZA is born only at the level of NHY, in which the discernments of HGT are clothed, as explained, since it has only the discernment of the vessels of MA, which are the level of Malchut, which through the correction of the lines is divided into NHY.
And therefore, in order to be completed with vessels for HGT, it needs the coupling of nursing. For through nursing from the milk of its mother it attains the discernments of the vessels from the bottom Hey in the Einayim, in the secret of the verse, “Your eyes washed with milk, fitly set.” And through this coupling it acquires vessels of HGT. And then the level of ZA is completed in it, in the discernments of Nefesh and Ruach in wholeness, so that Ruach clothes in the vessels of HGT as is fitting, and Nefesh in the vessels of NHY. And in order to attain the GAR as well, it must rise as MAN for the second Ibur of Mochin, and then AVI couple from the discernment of Gadlut and they bestow upon it Mochin of GAR, and then it is completed entirely. Thus ZA is not completed before three couplings have passed over it, which are: the first Ibur, for three within three, that is, HGT inside NHY, since it has then only the vessels from the side of MA; and afterwards the coupling of nursing, through which it attains vessels from the side of BON, from the bottom Hey in the Einayim, when it attains vessels of HGT, and then HGT expand out of the NHY, since they already have vessels; and afterwards the second Ibur of Mochin, when it attains its GAR.
Indeed, the GAR of Atzilut, which are AA and AVI, do not need a coupling of nursing, for from the coupling of the first Ibur as well they attain vessels of BON, because the Nukva of the upper one has lights of BON from the discernment of the bottom Hey in the Einayim in wholeness, and in this they do not need the discernment of the male of MA, as above. And therefore, as soon as they are born they have vessels of HGT and NHY in wholeness, and they need only the second Ibur of Mochin, and that suffices. Thus they need no more than two couplings, which are the first Ibur, of Katnut, and the second Ibur, for the need of Mochin.
And now let us come to the very words of the ARI here, where he says, “At first, through the Ibur of the upper one, he began to sort the most select of them all, and from it the Nukva of Atik was made.” And this is the first raising of MAN, when all the discernments of the posterior of AVI and YESHSUT, and the seven lights of the seven kings, rose while all of them were included in the screen of Nekudim that was refined and rose to the discernment of the screen of the Rosh of SAG, as above (page 599, the passage beginning “He decreed”). And then the discernment of the Katnut of Atik and his Nukva came out there, for the discernments of BON that were included in the screen that rose also joined with this new coupling, though only from the most select of the discernments in them, which is the discernment of the Keter of BON. And afterwards Atik and the Nukva rose as MAN for the discernment of the second coupling, of Gadlut, to the Rosh of SAG; and then the Rosh of SAG coupled with AB, which are the Mochin, since the illumination of AB lowers the bottom Hey from the Einayim of the Rosh of SAG to the Peh, like the place of the coupling that applies in AB itself, and then the level of Keter comes out. And then Atik and the Nukva descend to their place and bring out ten Sefirot from below upward at the level of Keter for their discernment of Rosh, and afterwards they also expand from above downward for their discernment of Guf. However, it must be remembered that even so the discernments of the Katnut in them, which came out in them in the first coupling, did not change; for all the ten Sefirot of this Rosh and Guf expanded in the first vessel, of Keter, that they had at the time of the Katnut, so that from the Bina of Keter upward the ten Sefirot of the Rosh came out at the level of Keter, and from Bina downward the ten Sefirot of the Guf came out. So that the vessel of Keter, which had previously been only a single point, has now expanded into a complete Partzuf of Rosh and Guf, until the end of Atzilut.
And this is what he says, “And afterwards, through the coupling of the male of Atik with his Nukva, they raised and sorted the sparks that had fallen below, from the part fit for the Nukva of AA, and they entered the place of the Ibur in the secret of MAN, and they become a discernment of a Partzuf.” The meaning is that it is known that the whole of all the MAN belonging to all four worlds ABYA rose together, in the secret of records included in the screen, up to the Rosh of SAG; except that each Partzuf took only what pertains to its own discernment, and all that remained it left to the degree after it. And likewise the second Partzuf took the discernment of MAN, from that same whole, that belongs to its degree, and the rest it left to the Partzuf after it; and so did all the degrees, until the end of Assiya. And the two discernments of MAN that the Rosh of SAG sorted for itself, for the two couplings of Katnut and Gadlut of Atik and the Nukva, have already been explained. And all that remained in the whole of the MAN it left to the sortings of Atik and his Nukva, for the sake of AA and his Nukva.
And at first Atik sorted the discernment of the MAN that pertains to the coupling of Katnut of AA and the Nukva, which is for their very emanation, as above; for the essence of the Partzuf is from the coupling of Katnut, whereas the coupling of Gadlut is not the essence in any Partzuf, and is regarded only as a discernment of addition, whose way it is to be found in the Partzuf in the manner of coming and going, and not permanently. And therefore the Partzufim of Atzilut differ from the Partzufim of AK, for the Partzufim of AK came out in all their splendour at one time, whereas in the Partzufim of Atzilut even the GAR in them come out in two couplings. And the reason for the matter has already been explained in the preceding parts: it is by force of the ascent of the bottom Hey in the Einayim, in the secret of the partnership of the quality of mercy with judgment. And therefore in the Partzufim of Nekudim the bottom Hey came out in the Einayim in the secret of permanence, while here in Atzilut the bottom Hey came out in the forehead in the secret of permanence, except that there is joined to it permanently also the discernment of the bottom Hey that is in the Einayim, as above. And you should know that this addition that was made here is what causes the whole correction. For the breaking that occurred in Nekudim was because of the weakness of the Parsa: at the time of the coming of the new light of the Gadlut, which breached the Parsa, the Parsa no longer had the strength to keep the illumination from expanding also to the worlds of BYA of separation, and the second restriction was cancelled entirely. But now, by force of the ascent of the bottom Hey to the forehead, the Parsa received a great strength from Keter, which is the root of every Partzuf. And therefore the Parsa congealed and grew strong, in such a way that even at the time of the coupling of Gadlut, when a new light descends and breaches the strength of the Parsa, still the new light does not illuminate below the Parsa, to BYA. And therefore there is now an existence to the Gadlut, since it does not cancel the Katnut. And it will be further explained further along.
And after AA and his Nukva came out in the discernment of Katnut, as above, then AA returned and rose as MAN to Atik and the Nukva; and then Atik and the Nukva sorted the MAN, from the whole that SAG had left them, for the need of AA, that is, phase three of coarseness that is in the whole of the MAN. And then a coupling was made in Atik and the Nukva, and ten Sefirot came out at the level of Hochma. And this level is reckoned as a discernment of MA, for this is the rule: all the levels that come out anew are reckoned as the HaVaYaH of MA of Alephs. And that AA of MA sorted for itself the lower half of the Keter of Nekudim, and she became its discernment of Nukva, to whom it bestows its level of Hochma. Understand this.
And the remainder of the MAN after the level of AA, Atik gave to AA and his Nukva, and they sorted from them the MAN that pertains to the AVI of MA, that is, for the two couplings of Katnut and Gadlut. At first they sorted the MAN that pertains to the Katnut of AVI, and AVI were born at the level of ZA, as above. And afterwards AVI rose as MAN to AA and the Nukva, and they sorted the MAN of phase two and brought out ten Sefirot at the level of Bina. And AVI of MA descended to their place and clothed the HGT of AA. And for their discernment of Nukva they sorted the ZAT of the Hochma and Bina of BON, as written in its place.
And the remainder of the whole of the MAN that was left after the sortings of AVI, AA left to AVI. And they sorted the MAN that pertains to ZON: at first they sorted what belongs to the Katnut, and they coupled upon the MAN and brought out the Katnut of ZON, which is the level of NHY with HGT inside it, as above. And afterwards came the coupling of nursing, and they were completed also at the level of HGT. And they descended and clothed below the Tabur of AA, as written in its place. And the remainder that was left after the sortings of ZON, AVI left to ZON, and they sorted them for the sake of the Partzuf Atik of Beria, in the manner explained above; and Atik for the sake of AA, and so forth in like manner, as in the five Partzufim of Atzilut. And likewise the ZON of Beria sorted, from the remainder of the whole of the MAN that the AVI of Beria left them, for the need of the Atik of the world of Yetzira; and Atik sorted for AA, and so forth until the ZON of Yetzira; and the ZON of Yetzira sorted for the Atik of Assiya, and the Atik of Assiya for the sake of the AA of Assiya, and so forth, until the ZON of Assiya were sorted by the AVI of Assiya. And the remainder from the sortings of the ZON of Assiya are by then already reckoned as complete dross, which is not fit to be joined to holiness, and therefore they fell to the shells, from which the ABYA of the shells were built. However, many sparks of holiness remained in them, and moreover from the most important of them; and these are the ones that go on being sorted by the souls of the righteous in every generation, until the end of correction. And when all the sortings are completed, then the structure of the ABYA of the shells falls, for all their vitality is drawn out of them, which are the sparks that are fit for holiness. And then it will be said, “He will swallow up death forever,” etc.
